verdict.rationale: Solid documents capabilities that enable embedding it in existing pages: authoring custom elements and adding babel-preset-solid to an existing webpack/rollup config. A hands-on user reports it is small and easy to inject into other pages, and another reports running it on a largish web product, which covers both ends of the scale. However, there is no first-party incremental-adoption or mounting-into-existing-page guidance. Missing for 10: an explicit documented incremental adoption path, docs on mounting into part of an existing page, migration guidance from small embed to full app.

support.subject: As a developer, I can incrementally adopt the framework, scaling from a small part of a page up to a full application

citations.quote: Web component friendly and can author custom elements
The easiest way to get set up is to add `babel-preset-solid` to your `.babelrc`, babel config for webpack, or rollup configuration
Uses Solid as a go-to for data viz because it is small and easy to inject into other pages.
Having used Solid on a largish web product for over a year, the user will not return to React.
